channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Down but not out: In war with Israel, Hezbollah shows it is still powerful
item.description: Despite setbacks, Hezbollah emerges as a key player, tied to Lebanon’s stability and US-Iran negotiations.

item.title: Trump reviews Iranian proposal aimed at reopening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The White House confirms Trump met his national security advisers on Monday to discuss the plan.

item.title: Iran war: What’s happening on day 60 as diplomacy gathers pace?
item.description: Trump team reviews Iran peace plan to reopen Hormuz with nuclear talks potentially delayed to a later stage.

item.title: At least 20 killed in Colombia highway blast
item.description: Colombia's President Gustavo Petro has blamed a 'narco-terrorist group', led by a former FARC fighter, for the attack.

item.title: Oil prices rise despite Iran’s proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Brent crude rises 3 percent despite Iran's offer to reopen waterway in exchange for deferral of nuclear talks.

item.title: 14 killed in South Sudan plane crash near capital Juba
item.description: A passenger plane crashed southwest of South Sudan’s capital Juba, killing all 14 people on board.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump reviews peace plan; UN calls for Hormuz to reopen
item.description: UN chief says US-Iran standoff in the Strait of Hormuz risks triggering a global food emergency.

item.title: Pakistan accused of attacking Afghan university
item.description: Air attacks on the province of Kunar have killed at least seven people and injured 75, sources tell the BBC.

item.title: IS claims responsibility for Nigeria attack that killed 29 people
item.description: Authorities say the militants raided a football pitch where people had been gathering and opened fire at random.

item.title: Colombia offers record $1.4m-reward for rebel it blames for deadly bomb attack
item.description: Officials say a rebel leader known as "Marlon" ordered the attack in which 20 people were killed.
